title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Location: Richmond, Surrey

Hours: Part-time, 3 days per week

Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of becoming permanent

£19,200 (FTE equiv. £32,000)

We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Finance Assistant to join a friendly and supportive organisation based in Richmond on a 6-month fixed-term contract.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Finance Assistant with strong accounts payable experience who enjoys working in a busy environment where accuracy, attention to detail and a methodical approach are essential.

The position is initially for six months, with the possibility of becoming permanent.

Key Responsibilities -

Processing a high volume of purchase invoices and financial data accurately

Preparing and processing weekly payment runs

Managing accounts payable transactions and supplier queries

Reconciling supplier statements and resolving discrepancies

Maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records

Supporting the wider finance team with general accounting and administrative duties

About You

The successful Finance Assistant will have:
- Previous experience in an accounts payable or purchase ledger role
- Experience preparing and processing weekly payment runs
- Excellent data entry skills with a high level of accuracy
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills
- Confidence using accounting systems and Microsoft Excel
- The ability to manage a busy workload and meet deadlines
- A positive, flexible and hands-on approach
- You will be comfortable working independently as well as being part of a small, supportive team.

What's on Offer?
- Part-time hours - 3 days per week
- A 6-month fixed-term contract
- Friendly and welcoming working environment
- An interesting and varied finance role
- The possibility of a permanent opportunity

We welcome applications from candidates who are immediately available as well as those currently working and serving a notice period.

If you are an experienced Finance Assistant looking for your next opportunity in Richmond, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about this Finance Assistant opportunity

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
If you're a Finance Administrator who enjoys getting stuck into the detail, taking ownership of your workload and being part of a business where your contribution actually matters, this could be worth a look.

This is a varied role, you'll be looking after the day-to-day transactional finance, keeping things running smoothly and supporting the Management Accountant with month-end reporting.

There's a good mix of responsibility here, and you'll have the opportunity to get involved in more than just processing invoices.

What you'll be doing:
- Managing the sales and purchase ledgers, including invoicing, allocations and supplier payments.
- Looking after credit control and keeping on top of outstanding balances.
- Completing bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Preparing payment runs and processing employee expenses.
- Assisting with VAT returns.
- Supporting the Management Accountant with month-end accounts, including accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Monitoring company expenditure and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Dealing with finance queries and supporting the wider business with general administration.

What do you need?

You'll ideally have experience in a similar role, with an understanding of transactional finance.

Experience using Sage and Excel would be useful, along with the ability to manage your own workload without needing someone to constantly look over your shoulder.

More importantly, you'll be organised, reliable and comfortable dealing with people across the business.

You don't need to be someone who wants to become a Finance Director in five years. If you're good at what you do, enjoy working in finance and want a role where you're trusted to get on with things, that's absolutely fine.

What's on offer?
- An annual salary of up to £30k (depending on experience)
- Hybrid working (2 days WFH)
- 28 days annual leave + birthday + stats
- Access to company benefits package after probation

Interested? Click "apply now" to find out more.

title: Accounts Receivable Controller
description:
Accounts Receivable Controller
Nigel Wright are currently supporting a North Yorkshire based organisation with their temporary Accounts Receivable Controller requirement. This will be an initial 3 month assignment with hybrid working offered.

The Role
As Accounts Receivable Controller, you will:
- Manage the credit control process across a high-volume ledger
- Monitor aged debt and deliver against collection targets and KPIs
- Allocate payments and remittances accurately
- Reconcile debtor and control accounts
- Ensure invoices and credit notes are accurate, authorised and issued on time
- Maintain reliable records of rates, contract terms and billing arrangements
- Investigate billing discrepancies, unbilled income and changes affecting charges
- Resolve queries while maintaining positive customer relationships
- Strengthen policies and procedures covering income, sales ledger and aged debt
- Support revenue reporting and cash-flow forecasting

The Candidate
You will bring significant credit control experience, ideally gained in a comparable high-volume environment. You will have a strong understanding of sales ledger processes and the proven ability to reduce debt without compromising customer service.
Strong Excel skills, attention to detail and the ability to remain organised under pressure are essential. You will be proactive, comfortable working to deadlines and targets, and able to use your initiative while contributing effectively as part of a team.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Consortium Professional Recruitment are working with an established organisation in Pocklington to find a Finance Assistant who enjoys being involved, taking responsibility and making sure things happen when they should. You'll be joining a team where your contribution will be valued, with the opportunity to work across several areas of finance rather than being limited to one particular task.

The Opportunity:
As a Finance Assistant, you'll be involved in the financial activities that help keep a busy organisation running effectively.

You'll have the opportunity to:
- Process accurate monthly payroll, including PAYE, workplace pensions, P60s and P11 Ds.
- Maintain purchase and sales ledgers, process invoices, expenses and supplier payments, and assist with credit control.
- Complete bank and credit card reconciliations, administer petty cash and maintain fixed asset records.
- Support month-end and year-end activities, VAT returns and annual accounts preparation.
- Your work will directly contribute to a well-organised finance function, supporting informed decisions and helping the wider organisation operate with confidence.

About You:
You might already be working in an accounts team, supporting payroll or handling a mixture of finance responsibilities. What's important is that you're comfortable with numbers, enjoy finding solutions and can be relied upon to follow things through.

We're particularly interested in hearing from people who bring:
- Practical experience in finance or payroll, with an understanding of how accurate financial information supports a business.
- The confidence to work with spreadsheets, financial systems and detailed information.
- A methodical approach, with the ability to spot when something doesn't look quite right.
- The initiative to manage your own workload while knowing when to ask questions or involve others.
- A friendly, professional manner and the ability to build positive working relationships.
- Knowledge of Sage or Xero would be useful.

If you're studying towards AAT that's an added bonus.

The Benefits and Package:
In return, you'll enjoy:
- £29,000 to £32,000 depending on experience.
- Life insurance, healthcare scheme, company pension and 25 holidays + bank holidays
- A broad role offering exposure to payroll, financial accounting, reporting and audit processes.
- Opportunity to develop your career and complete further qualifications.
- Collaborative team working alongside an experienced and supportive Finance Manager

How to Apply:
If you're a Finance Assistant looking for a role with greater variety, or you're currently working in accounts or payroll and ready for your next move, we'd be pleased to hear from you!

This exciting Finance Assistant / Payroll Administrator opportunity is being managed by Consortium Professional Recruitment, a trusted recruitment partner with a Human First approach.

If you're ready to take the next step in your finance career, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your CV attached.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Sharp Consultancy are currently recruiting for a Payroll Administrator to join a business based in Harrogate on an ongoing temporary basis.

This is an immediate start opportunity, so we are particularly interested in candidates who are available to start straight away.

The successful candidate will support the payroll function, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing whilst providing administrative support across all aspects of payroll.

Key Responsibilities
- Preparing and inputting payroll data.
- Completing payroll reconciliations.
- Managing pension auto-enrolment and administration.
- Producing payroll reports.
- Calculating holiday pay.
- Responding to employee payroll queries.
- Carrying out National Minimum Wage checks.
- Processing starters and leavers.
- Updating employee banking details.

The Ideal Candidate
- Previous experience in payroll administration or payroll processing.
- Good understanding of payroll procedures.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Ability to work to deadlines in a busy environment.
- Available to start immediately or at very short notice.

The Opportunity
- Salary equivalent of £30,000-£33,000.
- Ongoing temporary assignment.
- Based in Harrogate.
- Immediate start available.

If you have previous payroll experience and are available immediately, we'd love to hear from you.
